item.title: Trinity Health Shelby - Top 100 Critical Access Hospitals Nationwide - John Foss Joins
item.description: Trinity Health serves Grand Haven all the way up to Shelby. With the main hospital in Muskegon the smaller surrounding hospitals are essential too for the local communities to provide health care to those who live closer and sometimes levels of care that might not require the "big hospital". Not that they are any less important, they can just be handled at a level with less pressure, equipment and staff. item.title: How Muskegon’s Arts & Culture Scene Generates $50 Million in Economic Impact Annually
item.description: As a keen observer of Muskegon’s arts and culture scene these past seven months, I have learned what is possible in the way of implementing a newly found cultural identity for a small town that only continues to grow with every passing year. While the latter sentiment is good to keep in mind, it only tells a small portion of the story for an objectively growing category of our beloved community, culturally and economically speaking. item.title: Kim Starks - The Equity Empowerment Program - Financial Advise to Help Stop Living Paycheck to Paycheck
item.description: Money. They say it's the root of all evil. "They" are probably most like you and me. Money is hard. Money is "never enough" and money seems to set people further and further into our "place" as time is going by.
